## README

# Authority OS Python SDK

Python SDK for Authority OS - Multi-tenant entity visibility operating system combining SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and social platform optimization.

## Installation

```bash
pip install authority-os-sdk
```

With optional dependencies:

```bash
# For async support
pip install authority-os-sdk[async]

# For CLI tool
pip install authority-os-sdk[cli]

# For streaming support
pip install authority-os-sdk[streaming]

# Install everything
pip install authority-os-sdk[all]
```

## Quick Start

```python
from authority_os import AuthorityOS

# Initialize client
client = AuthorityOS(api_key="your-api-key")

# Create an entity
entity = client.entities.create({
    "name": "Acme Corp",
    "website": "https://acme.com",
    "industry": "SaaS"
})

# Run an audit
audit = client.audits.trigger(entity.id)

# Wait for completion
completed_audit = client.audits.wait(audit.id)
print(f"Overall score: {completed_audit.overall_score}")

# Get recommendations
recommendations = client.recommendations.list(entity.id)
for rec in recommendations.data:
    print(f"[{rec.priority}] {rec.title}")
```

## Async Usage

```python
from authority_os import AsyncAuthorityOS
import asyncio

async def main():
    async with AsyncAuthorityOS(api_key="your-api-key") as client:
        entities = await client.entities.list()
        for entity in entities.data:
            print(entity.name)

asyncio.run(main())
```

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Set API key
export AOS_API_KEY="your-api-key"

# List entities
aos entity list

# Create entity
aos entity create --name "Acme Corp" --website "https://acme.com"

# Run audit
aos audit run <entity-id>

# View audit results
aos audit results <audit-id>

# Generate report
aos report generate <entity-id>
```

## Features

- **Sync and async clients** - Use blocking or async/await patterns
- **Automatic retry with exponential backoff** - Handles transient failures
- **Pagination helpers** - Auto-paginate through large result sets
- **SSE streaming** - Real-time audit and generation streams
- **Rich CLI** - Beautiful terminal UI with tables and progress bars
- **Type-safe** - Full Pydantic models with validation
- **Context managers** - Automatic resource cleanup

## Resources

### Entities

```python
# List entities
entities = client.entities.list(page=1, per_page=20, search="acme")

# Get entity
entity = client.entities.get(entity_id)

# Create entity
entity = client.entities.create({
    "name": "Acme Corp",
    "website": "https://acme.com"
})

# Update entity
entity = client.entities.update(entity_id, {"industry": "Technology"})

# Delete entity
client.entities.delete(entity_id)

# Auto-paginate all entities
for entity in client.entities.list_all():
    print(entity.name)
```

### Audits

```python
# Trigger audit
audit = client.audits.trigger(entity_id, audit_type="full")

# Get audit status
audit = client.audits.get(audit_id)

# Wait for completion
audit = client.audits.wait(audit_id, timeout=300.0)

# List audits
audits = client.audits.list(entity_id)
```

### Recommendations

```python
# List recommendations
recs = client.recommendations.list(entity_id, status="pending", priority="high")

# Complete recommendation
rec = client.recommendations.complete(recommendation_id)

# Dismiss recommendation
rec = client.recommendations.dismiss(recommendation_id)
```

### Reports

```python
# Generate report
report = client.reports.generate(entity_id, report_type="monthly")

# Get report
report = client.reports.get(report_id)

# List reports
reports = client.reports.list(entity_id)
```

### Content

```python
# Create draft
content = client.content.create_draft(
    entity_id=entity_id,
    content_type="faq",
    title="Common Questions",
    brief="Answer the top 10 customer questions"
)

# Publish content
content = client.content.publish(content_id)

# List content
pages = client.content.list(entity_id, status="published")
```
